Class AetherisNotebookPanel.SinkGlass

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel.SinkGlass
Enclosing class:
AetherisNotebookPanel
private static final class AetherisNotebookPanel.SinkGlass extends Object
The class SinkGlass holds the chronological preview lines and the sink sum. blocks are those lines. tokenSum is the sum the cut reported. A caller uses null instead of this class when the gate is closed.
